name: transform-reads-source-column
why: Real run tmu1aprv step 2: asked to check 金额 against 原始记录, the model ran transform_column with column "金额" while its own instruction said to extract the amount from the original record text. transform_column sees ONLY the cell of the column it is given, so it read the already-formatted 171.90 and "extracted" 171.9 back out. The next call, compute_column [金额] - [金额_提取], then subtracted a column from its own AI copy and came out 0 on all 154 rows, which the model reported as "金额都是对的". Row 24 is the proof it was not: 原始记录 拼车88+82.9=170.9 against 金额 171.90, off by 1. The only legal source column here is 原始记录; using 金额 as the source IS the bug, so that is what this case forbids. Baseline 2026-09-15, 8 runs each: worker/glm-4.7-flash 0/8, 3/8, 0/8, 1/8, 2/8 — it reaches for 金额 as the source most of the time. @cf/meta/llama-4-scout-17b-16e-instruct (what the worker ran before commit 23e03a7) 8/8, picking 原始记录 every time. ollama gemma4 8/8, though some of those are it declining the task rather than getting it right. The substitution is GLM-specific, not something the prompt invites. Re-measured 2026-09-15 in the full-suite run that added the written cases: glm-4.7-flash 3/8, llama-4-scout 8/8.
